core_obligations: Injective sheaf (proof lines 4391-4424): the augmentation spectral sequence degenerates because a_p^-1I is injective, so the Cech complex a_{0,*}a_0^-1I -> a_{1,*}a_1^-1I -> ... computes Ra_*a^-1I; by the Cech-complex lemma this is SheafHom(s(Z_{F(K)}^#), I), exact in positive degrees since s(Z_{F(K)}^#) is exact there (hypercovering acyclicity) and SheafHom(-, I) is exact; hence R^pa_*a^-1I = 0 for p > 0, and degree zero holds by the sheaf-level descent lemma.
Bounded case (lines 4427-4435): represent E in D^+ by a bounded-below complex of injectives; Leray's acyclicity plus the first paragraph compute Ra_*a^-1I^bullet = a_*a^-1I^bullet = I^bullet.

Unbounded case, setup (lines 4438-4533): test on RGamma(U, -) for every U; choose K-injective representatives I^bullet of E and J^bullet of a^-1E; the simplicial resolution lemma expresses a^-1Z_U^# as the g_{p!}-complex; the K-injective RSheafHom machinery rewrites RGamma(U, Ra_*a^-1E) as Tot_pi(B) with B^{p,q} = Hom(a_p^-1Z_U^#, g_p^-1J^q) and RGamma(U, E) as Tot_pi(A) with A^{p,q} = Hom(a_p^-1Z_U^#, a_p^-1I^q), the term identification passing through the j_!-tensor remark.

Unbounded case, conclusion (lines 4536-4560): a_p^-1I^bullet and g_p^-1J^bullet are K-injective and both represent a_p^-1E, so the induced map A^{p, bullet} -> B^{p, bullet} is a quasi-isomorphism for every p; the More on Algebra product lemma promotes this to a quasi-isomorphism Tot_pi(A) -> Tot_pi(B), whence the left vertical arrow RGamma(U, E) -> RGamma(U, Ra_*a^-1E) is a quasi-isomorphism for every U.
proof_roadmap: Degen the augmentation spectral sequence on injectives; read acyclicity off the hypercovering.
Unbounded: compare product-total complexes termwise and promote with the product quasi-iso lemma.
difficulty_reason: Derived-categorical descent statement (statement 4384-4392, proof 4394-4565): the injective and bounded halves are complete two-citation arguments; the unbounded half - announced 'we urge the reader to skip this' - is in fact fully carried out with K-injective replacements, the simplicial resolution, both double complexes written term by term, and the product quasi-isomorphism promotion; no step is left to the reader. H3: 172-line proof spanning four chapters' machinery.
